data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 训练策展器以互信息和边际成功奖励筛选知识条目，条目加入知识库并提升后续任务，属于持续记忆改进方法。

scope_support.feedback_quote: We couple feedback inspired by token-wise mutual information (MI) with marginal success rewards to guide knowledge accumulation.
scope_support.object_quote: we propose Knowledge Weaver, a reinforcement learning framework that trains a language model to curate reusable knowledge from agent trajectories.
scope_support.persistence_quote: Together, these signals encourage the curator to preserve distinct information from experience and produce entries that improve task success when added to existing knowledge.
